title: Agent-Hub CLI Harness Report
description: Report produced by the control-cli harness. Records the result of driving a terminal command deterministically with tmux or PTY fallback.

cli_harness_report_id.description: Unique identifier for this harness run instance.

status.description: Overall result: pass=all steps matched, fail=a step did not match or command errored, timeout=a pattern-wait exceeded its deadline.

steps.description: Ordered list of action/expect steps executed during the run.

transcript_path.description: Path to the full transcript capture file (relative to repo root or absolute).

cleanup_ok.description: True if the tmux session or PTY process was successfully cleaned up after the run.

driver.description: The driver used for this run.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the report was generated.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the command, or null if unavailable.

action.description: The action performed in this step (e.g. 'start', 'send', 'wait').

expect.description: The regex pattern waited on in this step, or empty string if no wait was expected.

matched.description: Whether the expected pattern was found in the output.

capture_path.description: Path to the captured output for this step, or null if no capture was taken.
